command: ls -la documents output skills; for f in documents/*; do echo "== $f"; parse-doc "$f" | wc -c; done
mkdir -p /workspace/txt; for f in documents/*; do b=$(basename "$f"); e="${b##*.}"; parse-doc $e "$f" > /workspace/txt/$b.txt; done; wc -c /workspace/txt/*
cd /workspace/txt; for f in *.txt; do sed -E "s/ {2,}/ /g; s/-{4,}/--/g; /^\s*-*\s*$/d" $f > ${f%.txt}.c; done; wc -c *.c
python3 -c "import docx, openpyxl; print(docx.__version__ if hasattr(docx,\"__version__\") else \"ok\", openpyxl.__version__)"; ls skills/docx/scripts skills/xlsx/scripts; which soffice libreoffice

cd /workspace && python3 build/gen_xlsx.py && cd skills/xlsx && python3 scripts/recalc_libreoffice.py /workspace/output/red-flag-tracker.xlsx /workspace/output/red-flag-tracker.xlsx 2>&1 | tail -3; python3 scripts/scan_errors.py /workspace/output/red-flag-tracker.xlsx; python3 scripts/validate.py /workspace/output/red-flag-tracker.xlsx; echo rc=$?

cd /workspace && python3 build/gen_docx.py && python3 skills/docx/scripts/validate.py output/red-flag-memo.docx; echo rc=$?; parse-doc docx output/red-flag-memo.docx | wc -w; parse-doc docx output/red-flag-memo.docx | head -c 5000

cd /tmp && soffice --headless --convert-to pdf /workspace/output/red-flag-memo.docx --outdir /tmp >/dev/null 2>&1; pdfinfo /tmp/red-flag-memo.pdf | grep Pages; pdftotext -layout -f 3 -l 3 /tmp/red-flag-memo.pdf - | head -60

cd /workspace && python3 build/gen_docx.py && python3 skills/docx/scripts/validate.py output/red-flag-memo.docx; cd /tmp && soffice --headless --convert-to pdf /workspace/output/red-flag-memo.docx --outdir /tmp >/dev/null 2>&1; pdfinfo /tmp/red-flag-memo.pdf | grep Pages; pdftotext -layout -f 2 -l 2 /tmp/red-flag-memo.pdf - | head -40; pdftotext -layout -f 6 -l 6 /tmp/red-flag-memo.pdf - | head -30

cd /workspace && python3 build/gen_docx.py && python3 build/gen_xlsx.py && cd skills/xlsx && python3 scripts/recalc_libreoffice.py /workspace/output/red-flag-tracker.xlsx /workspace/output/red-flag-tracker.xlsx | tail -1 && python3 scripts/scan_errors.py /workspace/output/red-flag-tracker.xlsx | head -3 && python3 scripts/validate.py /workspace/output/red-flag-tracker.xlsx && python3 /workspace/skills/docx/scripts/validate.py /workspace/output/red-flag-memo.docx && parse-doc xlsx /workspace/output/red-flag-tracker.xlsx | head -c 1500 && ls -la /workspace/output
